g.text: Five execution rules on the same frozen strict-positive products

g.text: OOF: 120 paths per served profile and strategy; each profile keeps its original horizon and fold-specific target.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Individual L: B=25%, C=40%, E=35%. A and D retain 120 Review rows each per rule, with financial outcomes NULL.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: P10/P90 use the empirical inverse CDF; CVaR90 averages the worst 10% mass. Annual observations only.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Reused development paths and overlapping training folds; fan gates are model-relative heuristics, not risk certificates.
